source_policy: Only first-party curling clubs and competition organizers. Every document references its own source. These are evidence-based references, not Curling I/O roster identities or current team confirmations.

records.title: 2017 Tim Hortons Brier
records.detail: Curling Canada reports that Team Newfoundland and Labrador won the 2017 Tim Hortons Brier and earned a place in the 2017 Ford World Men's Curling Championship.
records.advancement: Qualified to represent Canada at the 2017 Ford World Men's Curling Championship

records.title: Dauphin Clinic Pharmacy Cash Spiel - runner-up (2009)
records.detail: The Manitoba Curling Tour source spells the name Farrol Asham and identifies him with Travis Graham, Grant Brown and Glen Ringrose on the runner-up team. The source spells the name Farrol Asham; the Ferrol spelling is an unverified search variant, not a confirmed identity link.
